title.narrative: UNFPA humanitarian action in Ukraine and Moldova 2022

description.narrative: This allocation contributes to meeting the objectives of UNFPA’s response in Ukraine and Moldova and hence seeking 65.6 million USD to provide access to basic sexual and reproductive health services including support to safe births, access to voluntary contraception and specialized services for GBV-survivors, including post-rape treatment, mental health and psychosocial support and emergency cash assistance.

This allocation of 25 million DKK to UNFPA contributes to meeting the objectives of the UNFPA Ukraine Appeal for 2022, which points to 11.9 million fleeing people in need of assistance and calls for 65.6 million USD for the remaining of 2022 (April-December) in response to the escalated humanitarian crisis. UNFPA is now scaling-up its humanitarian operation to provide access to basic SRH services, training, commodities, mental health and psychosocial support services and emergency cash assistance.
This allocation contributes to meeting the objectives of UNFPA’s response in Ukraine and Moldova and hence seeking 65.6 million USD to provide access to basic sexual and reproductive health services including support to safe births, access to voluntary contraception and specialized services for GBV-survivors, including post-rape treatment, mental health and psychosocial support and emergency cash assistance.
Due to its nature as a response to a humanitarian appeal operational results are general and highly aggregated and the MFA contribution is thus reflected in the overall results reporting by the partner. Please refer to the hyperlink below.
https://www.unfpa.org/data
